name: frontend-spec-plugin
description: Collects missing PRD, prototype, and API inputs before turning a frontend feature request into an implementation-ready specification.

interface.longDescription: A frontend-focused specification pipeline for requests to add, create, design, or develop a frontend feature. It collects missing requirement, prototype, and API inputs, asks developers to resolve user-visible behavior, requires explicit approval of the interaction draft, and only then produces flows and an implementation-ready specification without scanning the surrounding project or generating application code.
defaultPrompt: Add a frontend feature. First ask me for any missing PRD, prototype, and API inputs.
Design this frontend feature and collect the required specification inputs from me first.
Turn my inputs into a frontend specification and wait for my interaction approval before finalizing it.
